concerns.text: FR-008 (a‑priori power analysis) is defined in the specification but no task in the implementation plan references it. The plan’s Task T-012 performs a power analysis but is labeled only with SC‑001‑003 and does not cite FR‑008.
SC-004 (reproducibility match within 1e‑4) is not linked to any task. The plan’s CI reproducibility workflow (T-011) should be annotated with SC‑004.
SC-005 (compute feasibility within GitHub Actions free‑tier limits) is absent from the task mapping. The CI workflow T-010 enforces runtime/ram limits but does not reference SC‑005.
SC-006 (≥90 % participant‑task observations) is not covered by any task. No task records or validates the required data‑collection completeness.
SC-007 (power analysis must indicate ≥80 % power) is not mapped. Although T-012 runs a power analysis, it is not linked to SC‑007.
SC-008 duplicates SC‑006 but is also unreferenced; no task asserts the ≥90 % completeness target.
Task T-001 (create requirements.txt) is not associated with any FR or SC. It should be linked to FR‑007 (reproducibility package) or an appropriate SC.
Task T-002 (download Defects4J) is only linked to principles I, III, VII; it should also reference FR‑001.
Task T-003 (generate summaries) lists FR‑002, FR‑003 but omits FR‑001‑FR‑007 linkage for the overall pipeline; consider adding FR‑007 for completeness.
Task T-004 (latency test) is only linked to principle I; it should be tied to FR‑003 (timestamp precision requirement).
Task T-005 (simulation) lacks FR/SC annotation; it supports FR‑003 and SC‑006 but these are not referenced.
Task T-006 (PII hashing) is only linked to principles III, VI; it should also reference FR‑003 and FR‑006 (human‑subject protection).
Task T-007 (analysis) is linked to principles III, IV, V but should explicitly cite FR‑004, FR‑005, FR‑006, and the relevant SCs (SC‑001‑003).
Task T-008 (orchestrator) lists FR‑001‑FR‑007 but does not map to any SC; consider adding SC‑004‑SC‑008 where appropriate.
Task T-009 (GPU LLM generation) is only linked to principle VII; it should reference FR‑002 and SC‑001 (accuracy improvement) as it affects the LLM condition.
Task T-010 (CI workflow) lacks SC annotation; it should be tied to SC‑005 (compute feasibility) and SC‑004 (reproducibility verification).
Task T-011 (reproducibility workflow) is not linked to SC‑004; add the reference.
Task T-013 (README update) is only linked to principles I, VI; it should be associated with FR‑007 and SC‑004.
Task T-014 (citation validation) is only linked to principle II; it should be tied to FR‑007 (reproducibility) and SC‑004.
